changelog:
Equipment now says which slot it goes in.

* **A shield is no longer tagged a weapon.** A Buckler sat in the Equip list wearing the same red WEAPON badge as an axe. The badge was decided by "is it worn in either hand", and a shield is worn in one of them.
* **Ten tags instead of three.** `ARMOR` had been standing in for six different places you can wear something. Items are now labelled by their actual slot - **WEAPON, SHIELD, ARMOR, HEADGEAR, GARMENT, SHOES, ACCESSORY, AMMO**, plus **COSTUME** and **SHADOW**, which previously shared one badge. A two-handed weapon is still a weapon, and a dagger held in the off hand is still a weapon.

The colours have not changed - one for weapons, one for everything else you wear - so only the words are new.

This is a dashboard change. If you use the phone dashboard it is already live and this build is not needed for it; the overlay's own window carries its own copy of the dashboard, and this is how that copy gets the same fix.
